Remark
[path-space proof of connectedness]

Source: petersen:page-0286 ↗ def:pet-ch6-path-space-AB ↗ lem:pet-ch6-wilking-connectedness-principle 1. ch6:6.7.19Let $M$ be complete, $A\subset M$ compact, without invoking section 5. (1) Show non-stationary curves in $\Omega _{A,A}(M)$ deform to shorter curves in $\Omega _{A,A}(M)$. (2) Show stationary curves are geodesics perpendicular to $A$ at the endpoints. (3) If $M$ has $\sec >0$, $A$ is totally geodesic, and $2\dim A\ge \dim M$, show all stationary curves deform to shorter curves in $\Omega _{A,A}(M)$. (4) (Wilking) Conclude that $\pi _1(M,A)$ is trivial.
